system.description: When the force of Gave is called upon, sacred energy erupts from the priest and pierces an undead creature within the ability’s range. Undead struck by this energy receive damage without any chance of avoiding it. Armor does not protect against this ability. Only undead creatures can be harmed by it. The priest directs the energy in the form of glowing projectiles toward a group of undead creatures within range. There are four holy projectiles in the ability’s basic version. Each one deals 1d10 (OR 8-10) + 6 points of damage.
